name: Heterogeneous Sheep
paper_title: Heterogeneous sheep response variant (Strombom Collect/Drive base)
authors: HerdSim (inspired by heterogeneous shepherding literature, e.g. Hiraoka / Sueoka / Osuka)
mechanism: Strombom Collect/Drive with a mix of responsive and stubborn sheep. Stubborn sheep multiply shepherd repulsion (rs) by stubborn_rs_scale; types are assigned once from the run seed into metadata sheep_response.

assignment_modes.label: Collect: herder to outlier sheep being gathered.
Drive: herder to stand-off behind the flock.
